entries.title: Genesis 4:4

entries.title: Genesis 4:5
segments: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

entries.title: Genesis 4:8
segments: ¶And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

words.text: : and it came to pass, when they were in the field

entries.title: Genesis 4:9
segments: ¶And the LORD said unto Cain, Where [is] Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: [Am] I my brother's keeper?

entries.title: Genesis 4:10
segments: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground. {blood: Heb. bloods}

entries.title: Genesis 4:11
segments: And now [art] thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;

entries.title: Genesis 4:12
segments: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 4:14
segments: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, [that] every one that findeth me shall slay me.

entries.title: Genesis 4:15
segments: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

entries.title: Genesis 4:16
segments: ¶And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

entries.title: Genesis 4:17
segments: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch. {Enoch: Heb. Chanoch}

entries.title: Genesis 4:18
segments: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech. {Lamech: Heb. Lemech}

entries.title: Genesis 4:19
segments: ¶And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one [was] Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

entries.title: Genesis 4:20
segments: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and [of such as have] cattle.

entries.title: Genesis 4:21
segments: And his brother's name [was] Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

entries.title: Genesis 4:22
segments: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain [was] Naamah. {instructer: Heb. whetter}

entries.title: Genesis 4:23
segments: ¶And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt. {I have...: or, I would slay a man in my wound, etc.} {to my hurt: or, in my hurt}

entries.title: Genesis 4:24
segments: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
